note: PTF-CHARLOTTE-NC-ZERO-TO-LIVE-BENCHMARK-001 Charlotte census. Charlotte was built under the MODERN factory and has no legacy shadow market, so this census is written directly to identity_census/ -- the registered location -- rather than to a proposed directory it would later have to be promoted out of. No pinned census is overwritten: this order CREATES the file, and the release contract that pins its count is authored in the same registration batch. Every row carries the observations that produced it; nothing here carries a pet policy.
